name: ai_skills
description: AI agent skills that help you understand code before and after you change it: visual change guides, usage trees, change-impact maps and file-by-file feature build guides.
author: romashka50 <roma.buchuk@yahoo.com>

skills.visualisation: Self-contained HTML visual guide that explains code changes or a topic line by line, with diagrams and the reason for each change.
skills.component-usage-tree: Interactive, clickable tree of who uses the components, modules or functions changed in a diff, with flagged risks.
skills.change-impact-map: One HTML page combining the visualisation guide and the usage tree: what changed, why, who uses it, what could break.
skills.guided-implementation: Plans a feature through an interview, then writes a file-by-file build guide with copyable snippets that you apply by hand.
